beats: Hook: the creator stands in front of a green-screen classroom and says the 'this is how the zodiac signs react when they get a 1' line to camera.

Sign 1, the calculating know-it-all (e.g. Virgo/Capricorn): calmly answers the off-screen teacher ('Sorry? I got a 1?'), then denies it: 'No, you didn't give me a 1, because that's not in my calculation.' The teacher asks why, and the sign says they use Memo AI and acts shocked that the teacher hasn't heard of it.

Sign 1 brag (product mention, about 5 sentences, said fast and smug): 'I just take a photo of what I wrote in my notebook in your class, up to ten photos. In a few minutes Memo AI turns it into notes that explain everything step by step. It makes me flashcards and a quiz with explanations, and even a podcast I listen to on the bus. Then I do a practice test and it gives me a percentage and feedback on every answer. So trust me, check again, because with Memo AI that just isn't possible.' Ends with a smug 'Thank you.'

Sign 2, the explosive/vengeful one (e.g. Scorpio/Aries): laughs in disbelief at the 1, hands an imaginary object off-screen ('Hold this, hold this for me'), then intimidates the teacher with over-the-top comic bargaining ('Let's just change that 1 to a 5... fine, a 4, but 5'). It must stay clearly absurd and must not threaten anyone for real.

Sign 3, the family star who panics (e.g. Leo): 'What do I tell mum and dad?!' They spiral about being the smartest in the whole family ('grandma, grandpa, auntie all say I only get 5s'), call it the first 1 of their life and step away to 'call dad'.

Sign 4, the indecisive and distracted one (e.g. Libra): mishears the teacher as commenting on their split ends, gets stuck choosing between a drugstore hair oil and an expensive French one, and asks the teacher to decide. The video ends abruptly on this joke with no outro.
A20261008224450.filming: Length is 2:00–2:45, one continuous take or quick jump cuts between signs. The creator is vertical 9:16, waist-up, filmed on the front camera, in front of a green-screen still of a school classroom. The teacher is never seen: the creator looks slightly off-camera at desk height and reacts to silent lines ('Molim?' / 'Sorry?'). Each sign change is a hard cut, with an optional small zodiac emoji or sign name as a text label. No costume changes are needed, but a different posture, voice and energy per sign is required. The demo is verbal only, inside beat 3. An optional 2–3 second picture-in-picture or green-screen swap may show the Memo AI web app on a phone: the Scan camera photographing notebook pages, then the generated note, then flashcards or the practice-test percentage screen. The app shown must be memoai.eu in a phone browser, not an app-store app. Captions are in the local language.
A20261008224450.hook: Opening line spoken straight to camera over the green-screen classroom: "Tako se horoskopska znamenja odzovejo, ko dobijo enko v šoli." ("This is how the zodiac signs react when they get a 1 at school.") The localised equivalent goes on every country page. In all target countries a 1 is the failing grade.
not_allowed: Turning it into a straight tutorial, talking-head review or app walkthrough. The product must stay inside one character's rant in the middle of the video.
Ending on the product or adding a spoken CTA/outro. The video must end on the last sign's joke.
Showing the teacher on screen, using a second actor, or dropping the 'getting a 1' premise
Real-sounding threats, doxxing or naming real people's addresses or criminal records. Sign 2's intimidation must stay absurd bargaining.
